Function: Host that reads the module and writes the state file and UART
Operating voltage: 5 V logic from pin 2; I2C is 3.3 V
Connection: pin 2 5 V logic, pin 6 GND, pin 3 SDA, pin 5 SCL, pin 8 TX, pin 10 RX
Verification: NVIDIA Jetson Nano Developer Kit User Guide DA_09402
Notes: I2C is /dev/i2c-1. UART is /dev/ttyTHS1. Do not put pack voltage on a header pin. Do not use pin 1 (3.3 V) or pin 4 for the module. Jetson power is outside this monitor

Notes: Address 0x45 (decimal 69) with jumpers open. Also 0x44 and 0x41. Conductive path 200 µΩ typical. Driver accepts DEVICE_ID 0x2281 only. Which of INA228 or INA238 is fitted is unverified until that register is read. I2C pull-up rail is unverified: measure SDA idle before connecting

Connection: PLA or PETG, M3 through the case tabs, no screws through the PCB
Notes: Base with tabs 49.8 x 26.8 x 10.0 mm. Body 33.8 x 26.8 x 11.8 mm. Lid print 33.8 x 26.8 x 4.2 mm. See battery/enclosure/README.md

Verification: Matek packing list on the product page
